issues.title: Missing GWT for Core Naming Rules
issues.why: While AC-10/11/12 cover ORM and Booleans, the fundamental 'Golden Rules' (Singular names, PascalCase, PK={Table}Id) lack explicit GWT criteria in the AC file.
issues.fix: Add AC-14 with GWT steps to verify Table/Column naming and PK/FK identity matching against the Canonical DDL.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Smallest Type' Enforcement
issues.why: Rule 1.1 and 2 suggest using SMALLINT/TINYINT, but the Canonical DDL uses INTEGER for everything, creating a conflict for a mediocre coder.
issues.fix: Update Canonical DDL in 00-overview.md to use SMALLINT for ProjectStatusId to demonstrate the sizing rule.

issues.title: Inconsistent View Naming Prefix
issues.why: 01-naming-conventions.md specifies 'Vw' prefix for views, but the Canonical DDL in 00-overview.md uses 'View' suffix (ProjectWithOwnerView).
issues.fix: Standardize on 'Vw' prefix in the Canonical DDL (e.g., VwProjectWithOwner).
